gaps: WEB_CANDIDATE_CONFIDENCE_FINITE_RANGE_GAP
The web verifier converts result_confidence_percent with float() and checks only confidence < 96; NaN makes that comparison false and values above 100 are accepted.
Require math.isfinite(confidence) and 96 <= confidence <= 100 for every current candidate and visible example.
WEB_CANDIDATE_PARCEL_ID_BINDING_GAP
Current candidate web binding verifies row number, HMLR ID, metric and value but does not require row 30762/46142/61522 to carry parcel_30762/parcel_46142/parcel_61522.
Bind the exact row-parcel-HMLR tuple at both local candidate and served example gates.
WEB_CANDIDATE_MEDIAN_RANGE_GAP
Candidate validation requires finite min, max and median but never requires min <= median <= max.
Reject any median outside the exact EA min/max interval and record the three absolute statistics.
WEB_JSON_NONSTANDARD_CONSTANT_GAP
Python json.loads and requests.Response.json use the standard decoder, which accepts NaN and Infinity by default.
Use parse_constant that raises and a strict decoder for every candidate, manifest, operation, source and example document.
WEB_SESSION_TRUST_ENV_GAP
The loopback verifier creates requests.Session without disabling trust_env, so proxy and netrc environment settings may affect supposedly local acceptance traffic.
Set trust_env=False, clear proxies/auth and record the effective adapter and peer endpoint.
WEB_CROSS_ROLE_CHILD_FILENAME_COLLISION_GAP
Operation, source and example filenames are checked for duplicates only within each role; the same basename can appear in more than one role.
Require one unique basename set across all manifest child roles and bind each child to exactly one schema.
WEB_OPERATION_NUMBER_ABSOLUTE_RANGE_GAP
Operation numbers must be contiguous and unique, but their required absolute first and last numbers are not pinned.
Require the exact expected start/end range and reject negative, shifted or overflow ranges.
WEB_SOURCE_EXAMPLE_EXPECTED_COUNT_REQUIRED_GAP
Source and example expected counts default to the filtered actual length when manifest fields are absent.
Require explicit non-negative bounded expected counts in the manifest and match raw and accepted row counts.
WEB_SOURCE_ROW_OFFICIAL_HTTPS_SCHEMA_GAP
Visible source rows need only non-empty publisher and source_url fields; scheme, authority host and evidence fields are not validated.
Require HTTPS, an approved official host, unique source ID and non-empty fact/limitation fields.
WEB_NONOBJECT_SOURCE_EXAMPLE_DROP_GAP
Non-object source and example list members are silently filtered before count defaults are calculated.
Reject the entire document if any row is not an object; never silently drop malformed members.
WEB_CHILD_FILE_COUNT_LIMIT_GAP
Manifest child file lists have no upper bound, allowing many sequential loopback requests and unbounded aggregate work.
Set exact or bounded child counts and aggregate response byte ceilings before fetching.
WEB_CANDIDATE_INPUT_FINAL_PATH_GAP
The required candidate path is resolved but not proven to remain inside the authorized task worktree after symlink or reparse resolution.
Open the file under the approved root and verify final-handle containment, volume and expected relative path.
WEB_OUTPUT_RECEIPT_ATOMIC_DURABILITY_GAP
The web receipt is written directly with open(..., w) and no unique temporary file, flush-to-disk or atomic replacement.
Publish strict JSON through a generation-nonce temporary file, fsync/Flush(true), atomic replace and remote hash readback.
WEB_TIMEOUT_AND_EXPECTED_ROWS_RANGE_GAP
CLI timeout and expected-operation-row values have no finite contract upper bounds.
Reject non-positive, overflow or above-contract timeout/count values before any file or network work.
HMLR_MATCHER_OUTPUT_EXACT_BINDING_GAP
HMLR preparation marks ready from matcher exit code 0 and matched_candidate_count == 3 without independently checking exact rows, parcel IDs, HMLR IDs, status and safety flags.
Reparse the matcher receipt strictly and require the exact three row-parcel-HMLR bindings plus unique native polygons.
HMLR_REDIRECT_FINAL_SCHEME_OBJECT_IDENTITY_GAP
Downloads allow redirects and check the final host but do not re-require HTTPS or bind the final object path/filename to the requested authority ZIP.
Require HTTPS after every redirect, bounded redirect count and exact final object identity.
HMLR_CATALOGUE_BODY_BOUND_GAP
The catalogue response is loaded fully into memory and hashed without content-type, final-host or byte-size limits.
Stream a bounded HTML response, verify final HTTPS host/content type and record byte hash, ETag and Last-Modified.
HMLR_SESSION_TRUST_ENV_GAP
The HMLR session inherits proxy and netrc environment configuration.
Disable trust_env for this official-source client or explicitly pin and receipt the trusted network policy.
HMLR_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_COUNT_RATIO_GAP
ZIP extraction caps total uncompressed bytes but not member count, per-member bytes or compression ratio.
Bound member count, member size and expansion ratio before extraction; fail closed on encrypted or unsupported members.
HMLR_WINDOWS_BASENAME_COLLISION_ADS_GAP
Archive members are flattened to source_name.name without rejecting case-insensitive duplicates, reserved device names or NTFS alternate-data-stream syntax.
Normalize Windows names, reject reserved/ADS forms and require a unique case-folded basename set.
HMLR_SEED_MANIFEST_IDENTITY_GAP
Seed loading checks status, three rows and distinct HMLR IDs but not slot task attempt continuation or the expected seed blob.
Bind the seed manifest to slot, task, attempt, continuation, source blob and generation before downloading.
HMLR_TIMEOUT_RANGE_GAP
Download and matcher timeout CLI values are not range-checked.
Require finite positive contract-bounded timeout values and record effective connect/read/process deadlines.
CANDIDATE_STREAM_FEATURES_CONTEXT_GAP
The binary extractor locates the first regex match for a features array without proving it is the top-level GeoJSON key outside a string.
Use a streaming JSON parser that validates the root object and exactly one top-level features array.
CANDIDATE_CHUNK_OBJECT_MEMORY_BOUND_GAP
chunk_bytes has only a minimum and target feature objects have no maximum byte limit although max_feature_object_bytes is merely observed.
Apply bounded chunk and feature-object sizes before allocation and fail closed on oversized objects.
